# Names applied from the ff9-ds port's evidence (branch worktree-agent-a52060f77a83c91a1), for re-applying
# after merges. Each "## bin" section is a `python3 tools/rename.py --bin BIN --from FILE` list ("OLD NEW  # why").
#
# `# FIELDS` lines are prose for people, not a parse format: many name several structs in one line, so a parser
# can attach a mapping to the wrong struct. To map old unkXX fields to new names mechanically, match by offset
# (e.g. gdb `ptype /o`, or the `/* 0xNN */` offsets in the headers). New FIELDS lines name one struct each.
#
# Before the main section, the BIOS stub chunks were split by adding type:func placeholders to
# config/symbols.us.txt (func_80063118, func_80065218/28/38, func_80065E70/80/90/A0/B0), INCLUDE_ASM lines for them
# in src/main/main.c, matching lines in config/library_funcs.us.txt, then progress.py --write-index.
# func_80065238 -> strcpy needs --force (the builtin name is already used in ovl_39), the second strcpy prototype in
# ovl_39.h was dropped and ovl_64.h's became `char *strcpy(char *, const char *)` (cast at its one call).
# func_80016BA0 -> _bu_init is not in the function index: symbol line added and the C use renamed by hand.
# The ovl_0a/14/15 sections name references to ovl_64 functions inside those overlays (symbol lines added to their
# own symbols files, src and header renamed), since rename.py only renames inside ovl_64.
#
# Struct fields (FIELDS at the end): rename members in the header, then tools/rename_fields.py, one struct per run.
# Types renamed afterwards: Unk800761D0 -> CdLoadState, Unk8C8 -> PreloadQueue, Unk80021938 -> PreloadEntry,
# Unk800577EC -> AkaoVoiceRegs.

Every unkXX member declared Pool6CEntry * (or an array of them) in the module structs -> emitXX (834 members;

## Fields: effect model ids

(the effect model slot id later passed to Hi_DrawEffModel and friends) -> modelXX (476 members).

## Fields: model rotation / position / scale, emitter origins
SVECTOR/VECTOR members passed (only) as argument 0, 1 or 2 of Hi_DrawEffModel, Hi_DrawMorphEffModel, Hi_DrawSliceEffModel or
Hi_DrawSummonModel -> rotXX (202), posXX, scaleXX (81); members passed as the origin of btlfx_startEmitter are positions too
(posXX, 807 in all). Members used in more than one of these roles keep their unkXX name.

## Fields: motions, unit rotations and positions
BtlUnit9CC * members -> motionXX (41). SVECTOR members passed only to btlfx_getUnitRot / btlfx_setUnitRot -> rotXX (46);
SVECTOR/VECTOR members filled by the unit position getters (btlfx_getUnitPos/HomePos/BodyPos/StrikePos/WeaponPos/
BonePos/ArgBonePos, Hi_GetSummonBonePos) or given to btlfx_setUnitPos -> posXX (216).

# ===== literals pass =====
# Macros only (no symbol renames); each replaced literal compiles to the same bytes.
# psyq.h: setSprt8, setTile, setTile1, setTile8, setTile16, setLineF2, setLineG2 (PsyQ libgpu.h names), and
#   PRIM_LEN(type) = sizeof(type) / 4 - 1, the tag length of a primitive.
# setlen(p, N) in game code: setlen + code byte store -> set<Prim>(p); setlen(p, 1) + DR_TPAGE word ->
#   setDrawTPage(p, dfe, dtd, tpage); otherwise setlen(p, PRIM_LEN(T)) with T the primitive written next
#   (SPRT/TILE/... from the code byte, DR_STP for GPU_STP/_get_mask, DR_MODE for get_mode + get_tw).
#   Left: three setlen(p, 2) right before a SetDrawTPage() library call (ui.c, ovl_39, ovl_3a).
# ff9.h limits: HP_MAX 9999, MP_MAX 999 (chr_calcMaxHp/Mp, chr_calcEquipStats), DAMAGE_MAX 9999 (every HP/MP change
#   cap in btl_calcCmd's formulas and the fieldCalc_* item formulas; `>= 10000` written `> DAMAGE_MAX`),
#   RECORD_MAX 9999 (card wins/losses/draws, stealCount, dragonKills).
# snd_ids.h: SND_TYPE(w), SND_CMD(w), SND_PARAM(w), the three fields of a sound command word, used in the six mode
#   sound handlers (fld_soundCommand, wm_soundCommand, btl_soundCmd, tm_soundCmd, opening_soundCmd, ending_soundCmd).
# ff9.h UI_SPRITE_*: DPAD_UP..RIGHT (13-16, msg_renderText), HAND 1, GAUGE 2, HP 0xAF, MP 0xB0, TIME 0xB1, GIL 0xB2,
#   LV 0xB4, NEW 0xB5, NEW_BLINK 0xB6, HELP_TAG 0xB7, SCROLL_UP/DOWN 0xB8/0xB9, ABIL_ACTION 0xBC, ABIL_SUPPORT_ON 0xBD,
#   ABIL_ACTION_NA 0xBE, ABIL_SUPPORT_NA 0xBF, AP_MASTERED 0xC0, STONES 0xC1, TIMER_DIGITS 0xE0, TIMER_COLON 0xEA,
#   ABIL_SUPPORT_OFF 0xF4, EQUIP_SLOTS 0xF9 (+ slot). [code]: what each caller draws beside them.
# ovl_0b.h BTLFX_EFFECT_*: COMET, ATTACK (+ kind), ATTACK_ENEMY, STEAL_*, TRANCE, TRANCE_CMD, THROW_* (btl_startCmdEffect fixed ids)
# ovl_0b.h BTL_MOTION_*: IDLE 0, IDLE_WEAK 1, KO 4, WEAK_TO_IDLE 5, GET_UP 6, IDLE_TO_WEAK 7, READY 9, IDLE_TO_READY 10,
#   WEAK_TO_READY 11, DEFEND 12, DEFEND_IDLE 13, DEFEND_TO_READY 14, COVER 15, DODGE 16, FLEE 17, ATTACK 0x17,
#   ATTACK_RETURN 0x19, CHANGE_ROW 29 (+ row). Runtime questions for the rest: docs/wip/literals_runtime.md.
# psyq.h PRIM_TAG(type) = PRIM_LEN(type) << 24 (btlfx_addPrim / addPrimLenIn len words); ovl_0b.h BTLFX_ABR_OPAQUE 0xFF;
#   btlfx.c raw primitive code bytes -> GPU_* | GPU_ABE.
# psyq.h LINE_F3 (type), GPU_LINE_F3 0x48, GPU_LINE_TERM 0x55555555 (ovl_36 card cursor is a LINE_F3, not a POLY_F4).
# ff9.h PARTY_SIZE 4, EQUIP_SLOT_COUNT 5 (loops over GameData.party / Character.equip); CHR_COUNT for character loops and
#   the event ops character-index checks; BTN_TRIANGLE_ALT 0x1000000 (btlui_cmdInput pass turn).
# res_ids.h VRAM_FONT_X/Y (0x380,0x100) and VRAM_UI_SHEET_X/Y (0x3C0,0x100): the 4-bit pages behind tpage words 0x1E / 0x1F.
# snd_ids.h SND_SE_GROUP_MENU 0x800000, SND_SE_GROUP_SLOT(n) / SND_SE_GROUP_SLOTS (seMask groups), AKAO_SE_CH_BIT(i) (0x100 << i,
#   activeMask bits); SND_VOL_MAX for btl_playUnitSound and the music fade-in targets.
